//: Example v1 --validate file showing the THREE-ROLE gate for conventional software. Deterministic checks (which can APPROVE) run first; the Gemini adversary (which can only VETO, exit 3) runs last and only if they passed (skip_if_failed). Tokens: __PY__ = the supervisor's Python, __HARNESS__ = the folder holding run_issues.py/adversary.py, __CONFIG_DIR__ = the folder holding this file. Commands run with the repo as cwd. For ML projects start from _template_ml/ instead.

always.//: VETO-ONLY adversary. Sees the issue, the agent's result block, the diff and new files. Exit 3 = veto = commit blocked; its reasons are fed back to the agent's next attempt. Needs GEMINI_API_KEY; without it it prints UNREVIEWED, does not block, and logs to <run dir>/adversary_log.jsonl.
always.label: adversarial review (veto-only)
